activity_summary: You got into Davy's boat at Old Swan. You have not been on the river since May. Last Saturday you would not cross. This is the crossing. The timber is not in sight from the stair. You are not going to land.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Took the four of you, and told you to sit.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Said the no-landing into the boat.

facets.activity: Got into Davy's boat at Old Swan

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: I did not come to Old Swan to admire Old Swan
